title: Escrow Account Terms by Program for the Mortgage Loan File
content:
Whether a Mortgage Loan File may waive its tax and insurance escrow account, up to what base-loan-to-value, at what price, and how long escrow must be kept on a higher-priced mortgage loan are set per Larkspur program.

| Program | Escrow waiver allowed | Maximum base-loan-to-value for a waiver | Waiver price at closing (percent of the loan amount) | Minimum months of escrow on a higher-priced mortgage loan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | no | 0.00% (waivers not allowed) | 0.000% | 60 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | no | 0.00% (waivers not allowed) | 0.000% | 60 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | yes | 80.00% | 0.250% | 60 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | yes | 80.00% | 0.250% | 60 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | yes | 80.00% | 0.250% | 60 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | yes | 80.00% | 0.250% | 60 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | yes | 80.00% | 0.125% | 60 |

**Schedule notes**

- The waiver price is a percentage of the loan amount stated to 3 decimals; the loan-to-value limit is stated to 2 decimals.
- Hypothetical figure: a waiver priced at 0.250% on a loan amount of 400000.00 USD corresponds to 1000.00 USD; at 0.125% it corresponds to 500.00 USD.
- A base-loan-to-value of exactly 80.00% is at the waiver limit; 80.01% is above it.
